desc: The Mark I FVT is a reliable single-shot, bolt-action rimfire with serious features, including Savage Arms user-adjustable AccuTrigger technology for a crisp, personalized trigger pull. The 21-inch, blued, carbon steel heavy barrel is button-rifled for exceptional accuracy, and perfectly balanced with the rugged matte black synthetic stock. It weighs 5.25 pounds, with adjustable peep sights.
